prompt.alinti: This web app runs real Blender geometry nodes directly in your browser to generate three distinct architectural styles.
Instead of manually modeling every brick, it executes the exact logic from Blender files to procedurally build a Parisian apartment, a New York corner tower, or a Chinese residential block.
You can drag sliders to change floor counts, balcony types, and window details, watching the 3D model update live.
It even simulates weather with rain and snow, placing your building in a generated city backdrop.
The coolest part is that the code verifies its math against Blender's engine, ensuring the digital building matches the 3D model perfectly.
